payout_quote: Checking Accounts — You could earn $50 and your friend could earn $250. Auto Loans — You could earn $50 and your friend could earn $50. Personal Loans — You could earn $50 and your friend could earn $50. Credit Cards — You could earn $50 and your friend could earn $50.
steps: Be a Truity Credit Union member; register for the referral program
Enter your friends'/family's email addresses to send referral invites from your referral link
Friend registers from the invite and opens a qualifying Truity account (checking, auto loan, personal loan, or credit card)
Once the product conditions are met, you earn $50 per qualifying referral (friend earns $250 for checking, $50 for loans/cards)
catches: No limit on the number of referrals
Referrer earns $50 per qualifying product: checking, auto loan, personal loan, or credit card
Rewards are paid only once the friend meets the product conditions — see the full terms and disclosures linked on the official page for each product's conditions
Program terms apply to each product; amounts shown with asterisks referencing full disclosures
biggest_catch: $50 per referral with no cap — but the friend must actually open and qualify for a real product; read the linked full terms for each product's conditions.
eligibility: Truity Credit Union members; referred friends open qualifying Truity products
timing: Rewards paid once the friend meets the product conditions
